chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from 'Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام:
“Regarding the muhsan man and the muhsanah woman: one hundred lashes, then stoning.”

key_terms.الرَّجْمُ: stoning; a prescribed hadd punishment in this legal context
key_terms.الْمُحْصَنَةِ: the married or legally protected woman subject to the ruling of ihsan in this context
key_terms.الْمُحْصَنِ: the married or legally protected man subject to the ruling of ihsan in this context
key_terms.جَلْدُ: flogging; the prescribed punishment of lashes
key_terms.زُرَارَةَ: Zurarah, the well-known transmitter in the chain of narration
key_terms.مِائَةٍ: one hundred; the specified number of lashes

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in this hadith for the muhsan man and muhsanah woman in zina?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a legal ruling from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام concerning the hadd punishment for the muhsan man and muhsanah woman in the case of zina. It classifies the report within Islamic jurisprudence and judicial rulings dealing with prescribed punishments.
